body.label: Target
body.html: Self or one willing ally within 3 units.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Trigger: An enemy Action would deal Damage to the target. Response (unopposed): Reduce that Damage by 1; after the Action, the protected creature may move 2 units.

surges.html: The movement does not trigger movement Reactions from the attacker.
Reduce the Damage by 1 more if its source is your Locked target.
